_doc: Who walks how (WalkStyles, src/bodies/walk_styles.gd): a man's walk clip by his person id, else by his body model; clips in assets/animations/ (the Studio's motions/walks, Uthana). Sean, 2026-10-24: five ways of walking, all real.

library._doc: With Settings.library_motion on (LibraryMotion, #539): a man's library walk by name (assets/animations/library/<name>), else one of the CMU walks by his seed. His own clip above (people/models) still leads when it exists.
